On inference specifically: storing generated context is MORE ECONOMICAL THAN RE-RUNNING IT through compute and memory. Core cloud services (notably stored video/collaboration recordings) remain an underappreciated parallel driver, and cheaper open-source Asian models are viewed as demand-positive since more model access means more data
